description: This file defines an abstract class 'Target' that extends 'StagedBackup' and serves as a blueprint for backup target implementations within the vtiger CRM system. It includes abstract methods for starting and finishing backups, processing table creation statements, and handling individual table backups. The class also provides a method to add stage data, which triggers the appropriate backup processes based on the stage.

classes.name: Target
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a template for backup target implementations, defining the essential backup operations.

methods.name: startBackup
methods.description: Abstract method to initiate the backup process.

methods.name: processTableCreateStatement
methods.description: Abstract method to handle processing of table creation statements during backup.

methods.name: startTableBackup
methods.description: Abstract method to initialize backup for a specific table.

methods.name: processStatement
methods.description: Abstract method to process individual backup statements.

methods.name: finishTableBackup
methods.description: Abstract method to finalize the backup process for a specific table.

methods.name: finishBackup
methods.description: Abstract method to finalize the overall backup process.

methods.name: addStageData
methods.description: Method that performs actions based on the stage passed, calling the appropriate backup methods.
